newsitem.title: FRANCE: Saudis seek 1.2 mln tonnes barley - traders.
newsitem.headline: Saudis seek 1.2 mln tonnes barley - traders.

text.p: Saudi Arabia is to tender on Tuesday for 1.2 million tonnes of barley from optional origins, European grain traders said on Monday.
The barley includes 500,000 tonnes to arrive by the end of February and 700,000 by March 30, they said.
Traders said the deadlines made it likely most of the grain would come be exported from the European Union.
Some would also probably come from Australia and Canada.
Canadian grain trade sources said on Thursday Saudi Arabia was expected to tender for barley this week after being out of the market for some time.

Some traders had expected a major barley purchase over the New Year but sources on both sides of the Atlantic said this had been deferred, partly because of a two-week holiday shutdown in European grain markets.
Saudi Arabia is the world's largest barley importer.
